event.description: Use normalized sigmoid attention with one QKV union
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,640 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold. There have been 21 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0146/micro-0011 at 1,640/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0151, whose cosine-normalized Q/K attention scored 0.00% at 1,639. Hypothesis: vector norms are essential but exponential winner competition may not be; normalized sigmoid gates preserve incumbent dot products while bounding each causal compatibility weight. Add QKV pair 608/539 and replace only softmax with sigmoid followed by row normalization, yielding 1,639 parameters. This is more informative than ReLU-normalized attention because sigmoid is smooth and strictly positive, making it the closest non-exponential normalized alternative.
